title: NIST WebBook: Ammonium nitrate is H4N2O3, molecular weight 80.0434 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Ammonium nitrate as H4N2O3, molecular weight 80.0434 amu, CAS 6484-52-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Ammonium nitrate, CAS Registry Number 6484-52-2, lists molecular formula H4N2O3 and molecular weight 80.0434 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 80.0221919966 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/H4N2O3/c1-5-2(3)4/h1H4. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
